title: Force full injection of grounding at session lifecycle boundaries
context: Subagents start completely blind (orientation never fires inside them). Compaction summarizes injected grounding away while the dedup cache still claims delivery was successful, causing post-compact injections to become delta one-liners against context the agent no longer has. Touches invariant(s): con_8460b6770f (Config/provider writers must merge idempotently into existing user files and refuse to clobber an unparseable file).
decision: Emit SubagentStart hook to inject full grounding when subagents spawn. Reset injection dedup on PreCompact and SessionStart[source=compact], forcing all constraints to re-deliver in full after compaction resumes.
consequences: Subagents (Explore, Plan, Task) now start with active-constraint digest instead of empty context
Compaction can safely summarize away injected grounding; post-compact delivery is full again, not delta
Injection dedup scope expands: must track invalidation at session lifecycle events, not just per-edit
Two new hook event types required: SubagentStart and PreCompact
Session grounding now survives delegation and compaction cycles within a single session
alternatives_rejected: Keep subagents blind and extend PreToolUse to read-only agents — they'd still lack early orientation
Don't reset dedup on compaction; let post-compact injections be delta — loses critical context silently
Pass parent context to subagents via RPC at spawn — defeats uniform hook-based delivery pathway
